key_terms.الصَّمَدُ: The Eternal Refuge / The Self-Sufficient One

ai.seo_question: What does the title As-Samad mean in Surah Al-Ikhlas?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, As-Samad is interpreted not merely as 'self-sufficient' but as the ultimate source of all sustenance and authority, emphasizing that all creation turns to Him in absolute need. This attribute underscores the metaphysical reality that while Allah is free from physical needs, He is the essential ground of being for all existence. The term thus serves as a bridge between divine transcendence and immanent providence, central to understanding Tawhid in the Quran.
